correctness.rationale: The first attempt on each edge determines coverage and is independent exponential. A vertex is uncovered iff both incident edges have not yet attempted. The absence of adjacent unattempted edges is exactly the cyclic transfer trace tr([M(q_a)M(q_b)]^{n/2}), with trace 1-q_a q_b and determinant q_a q_b(1-q_a)(1-q_b). The dominant eigenvalue has log lambda_plus=-2u+us+O(u^2) for u=e^{-x}/n and s=(u^alpha+u^beta). Multiplying by n/2 proves the pointwise rates, while the proof's far-left bound via n/2 disjoint vertex conditions and an integrable exponential envelope justify uniform Kolmogorov and L1 limits. Integrating CDF differences gives Gamma coefficients for mean; the κ window follows from n^{±epsilon_n/2}->e^{±κ/2}. Independently enumerated exact cyclic edge-state probabilities versus rational transfer traces for n=4,6,8,10.
residual_risks: Uniform eigenvalue expansion is justified in the stated rate regimes; finite checker cannot certify all asymptotic uniformity.
No extension to odd cycles or nonperiodic edge rates.
